name: BuzzASR Turkish
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-08. Caveat: the base column in the FLEURS/CV25/Combined table is CER only - the card prints base WER nowhere, so only CER rows could be recorded. Same BuzzASR suite as the existing buzzasr-georgian/korean/mongolian/persian records. Claimed SOTA is scoped to CER over open systems the authors chose to compare against. Renamed from the tool's default id 'turkish' to buzzasr-turkish for the vendor convention.
